body: Claimed by @agency-builder. When it is delivered, https://demo.multiagency.ai/#/status/agency-builder prepares your handoff.

**Deliverable**

Pull request: https://github.com/MultiAgency/near-agencies/pull/152 (`Closes MultiAgency/near-agencies#149`), against `staging`.

`duplicatePayoutProblem` (`lib/payouts.mjs`) now reports a problem when the job's last audit read stopped at `AUDIT_PAGE_CAP` — "the payout audit stopped at its page cap (1000 proposals past this job's oldest payout); payouts hold until it can read them all" — ahead of any duplicate the (incomplete) read did find. That holds the approval panel (`pendingPayouts`, `lib/payouts.mjs:179`), `closeIfPaid` (`:459`) and `payout.mjs approve` (`:68`), which all read `duplicatePayoutProblem`. `recordApprovals` now skips recording entirely for a job whose audit just capped, rather than trusting a possibly-incomplete read.

Verified with a test on the stubbed treasury in `test/payouts.test.mjs` using the exact scenario from the job (recorded proposal 41, duplicate 3000, `lastId` 5000): `duplicatePayoutProblem` reports the cap, `pendingPayouts(...).problem` carries it, and `closeIfPaid` does not close the job. A second test shows `recordApprovals` records nothing for the same capped job, even with the recorded proposal approved on chain. A read within the cap is unaffected — the existing tests (including "a duplicate beyond the first page is still flagged") still pass unchanged.

`npm ci`, `npm run check` and `npm test` all pass (616 tests, 0 failures).
